samples.xml_description:
<module id="RAM">
    <description>Implement a dual-port RAM with a depth of DEPTH and a bit width of WIDTH bits, with all data initialized to 000000. It has two groups of ports, respectively for reading data and writing data, and read and write operations can be carried out at the same time. When the read_en signal is 1, the read_data of the corresponding position is read through the read_addr signal and output; When the write_en signal is 1, data is written to the corresponding position through the write_addr signal and write-data signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="write_en">Write enable signal to initiate a write operation.</input>
        <input id="write_addr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Address for the write operation.</input>
        <input id="write_data" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Data to be written to the RAM.</input>
        <input id="read_en">Read enable signal to initiate a read operation.</input>
        <input id="read_addr" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)">Address for the read operation.</input>
        <output id="read_data" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Output signal representing the data read from the RAM.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">6. Bit width of data.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">8. Depth of the RAM.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <reg id="internal_RAM" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0] [DEPTH-1:0]">Register array to store data.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Define a register array, internal_RAM, with a depth of DEPTH and a width of WIDTH bits. Initialize all memory locations to 0. Write data to the specified address when write_en is active. Read data from the specified address when read_en is active.</implementation>
</module>
